name: Tab Namer
description: Names an agent's tab after its task when the agent first finishes. Rule-based; an optional Haiku mode runs with no tools.

commands.title: Tab Namer: Name this agent's tab now

settings.title: Name tabs when an agent first finishes
Name with Claude Haiku
settings.description: Runs `claude -p` on Haiku with no tools, no MCP servers and no settings files, sending the first line of the task (at most 300 characters). Off: names come from the task text alone.
